chapter.title: Contributor registration
chapter.simpara: Every contributor is registered via a profile file conforming to the contributor schema at documentation/07-contributions/01-people/contributor.xsd. Profiles live under documentation/07-contributions/01-people/, one directory per contributor named after their GitHub username:

section.title: Validation
section.simpara:
The contributor schema uses XSD 1.1 features and requires an XSD 1.1-capable validator.
Until a dedicated tool is available, validate contributor profiles using Oxygen XML or another XSD 1.1-capable editor.

section.title: DocBook fragment generation
section.simpara: Two DocBook fragments are generated from each profile and committed alongside it: a full author element for document headers, and an abridged one for bibliographies. Regenerate them with Saxon after any change to the profile:
